Package org.odpi.openmetadata.frameworks.integration.dcat.jsonld

Class JsonLdNode

java.lang.Object
org.odpi.openmetadata.frameworks.integration.dcat.jsonld.JsonLdNode
public class JsonLdNode extends Object
JsonLdNode is a node in a JSON-LD graph. It has an identifier (an IRI or a blank node identifier), a set of types and a map of property IRIs to values.
